tours.name: Add a Work Entry Type
tours.description: Learn how to add a type of work entry, such as Night shift or Training, which defines how a kind of time is recorded and paid.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a type of work entry, such as Night shift or Training, which defines how a kind of time is recorded and paid.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Work entry types are configured in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Work entry types are configured in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as work entry types and working schedules.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as work entry types and working schedules.

steps.title: Work Entry Types
steps.description: Work entry types classify the time of an employee, for example Attendance, Paid leave or Training. Each type decides how that time is counted in payroll.

description_i18n.en_US: Work entry types classify the time of an employee, for example Attendance, Paid leave or Training. Each type decides how that time is counted in payroll.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to create a record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a record.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank form.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank form.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Use the name payroll officers will recognise, for example Night shift. It appears on work entries and on the worked days of a payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Use the name payroll officers will recognise, for example Night shift. It appears on work entries and on the worked days of a payslip.

steps.title: Code
steps.content: Type the code, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the code, then press Tab.

steps.description: The code identifies the entry type in salary rules and reports. Keep it short, in capital letters, for example NIGHT.

description_i18n.en_US: The code identifies the entry type in salary rules and reports. Keep it short, in capital letters, for example NIGHT.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the record.

steps.description: Saving creates the work entry type. It can now be used on work entries and on leave types.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the work entry type. It can now be used on work entries and on leave types.

steps.title: Saved
steps.content: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

steps.description: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.

description_i18n.en_US: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.
